notes: Dated checkpoints. tools/check_review_dates.py fails after a date passes, so the weekly workflow opens an issue and a person re-checks the sources. A checkpoint is a prompt to re-read sources, not a prediction that anything will change. Remove or move a checkpoint only after doing the work, and say so in CHANGELOG.md.

Prepare for more frequent renewals in late 2027. Decide whether to add renewal pages for people who are now members.
Prepare for 2028 proof rules. Replace 'In 2027, no doctor's note is needed' with current OHA guidance.
